channel.title: DBX updates
channel.description: What shipped in DBX — v1.2.0 recall, Isolation Kernel, walkthrough. Not a mail list.

item.title: v1.2.0 — recall an agent can actually call
item.description: v1.2.0 keeps Isolation Kernel and finishes the recall surface: VSEARCH MIN_SCORE/EF/SPACE, VSIM, VFUSE, playground tabs, public site. Better as a product; same 2.304 ms ANN p50 and 14–17 MiB strict idle RSS. GHCR :v1.2.0 publishes when the Release is tagged.

item.title: Tenant recall: VSEARCH, VSIM, VFUSE
item.description: Engine detail for the v1.2.0 cut. Per-tenant recall covers semantic VSEARCH (MIN_SCORE, EF, SPACE), similar-to-id VSIM, and late-fusion VFUSE. Embeddings stay with the caller. Certified ANN p50 is 2.304 ms.

item.title: v1.1.0 — Isolation Kernel
item.description: Linux strict: own process, Landlock, encrypted WAL/meta/graph. SQ8 .vec rows stay mmap plaintext. Not SOC 2.

item.title: Operator walkthrough
item.description: Site plus live dashboard, engineer voiceover, 140 BPM tech bed.

item.title: v1.0.0 — single-node GO
item.description: 100 tenants/node, 100k vectors/tenant, durable strings + vectors. Raft and cluster fail closed.
